includes: Three course dinner paired with wines
blurb: Guests can enjoy wine tastings daily from 11:30 to 5:00 in the Smitten Summerhouse. The winery hosts a Golden Hour Dinner series featuring three course Italian-themed dinners paired with wines, held on select Friday evenings in the vineyard. The dinners include live music and take place rain or shine at the Summerhouse at 4101 King Street in Lincoln, Beamsville.
